I tried all three, adding **travel** and saving in each. My current tag ("reading") stayed visible the whole time in every version, which I liked.

Version C feels the most natural to me. It shows me the tags I already have so I can just check off "travel," and it still gives me a box to make up a brand-new tag when I need one. That combination — pick from what I've got, or type a new one — is exactly how I'd want it, because it saves me from retyping tags I use all the time and from accidentally making slightly-different duplicates.

Version A (just typing every tag by hand) works fine too, but it doesn't remind me what tags already exist. Version B is quick to click but only offers a fixed little set, so I'd feel stuck when I want something not on the list.

So my pick is C. No need to spin up more options for me — that one does what I want.
